Two readings match when they require, forbid or permit the same acts, each on its own or together in the same way, with every modifier applying to the same acts; wording does not matter. Pair the A and B readings that match, each A and each B reading in at most one pair. For each pair name the L reading that matches it, or NONE; each L reading in at most one pair. Then name every L reading in which a modifier applies to some of the joined items but not to an item between them (a skipped middle). Use only the text below; do not use tools or outside knowledge. Answer with one line per pair, `PAIR A<i> B<j> L<k>` or `PAIR A<i> B<j> NONE`, then exactly one line `SKIPPED: NONE` or `SKIPPED: L<k>, L<m>, ...`, and nothing else.

SENTENCE: It can help us to grow and flourish; to become the best versions of ourselves; to understand each other, our values, and the ultimate stakes of our actions; and to act well in response.
DEMAND: It can help us to grow and flourish; to become the best versions of ourselves; to understand each other, our values, and the ultimate stakes of our actions; and to act well in response
In list L, {0} stands for it (AI).
A1. It (AI) is able to help us with each of these aims on its own: growing and flourishing, becoming the best versions of ourselves, understanding each other, our values and the ultimate stakes of our actions, and acting well in response. It can help with any one of them without helping with the others.
A2. It (AI) is able to help us with all of these aims together, as one combined outcome: growing and flourishing, becoming our best selves, understanding each other, our values and the stakes of our actions, and then acting well.
A3. It (AI) is able to help us act well specifically in response to the understanding just named (of each other, our values and the ultimate stakes of our actions), so the acting-well depends on that understanding.
A4. It (AI) is able to help us act well in response to whatever it helps us with in general, such as its help or the situations we face, not only in response to the understanding just named.
A5. It (AI) is able to help us "grow and flourish" as a single joint aim, rather than helping with growing and helping with flourishing as two separate aims.
B1. The AI is able to help us with each of these things on its own: to grow, to flourish, to become the best versions of ourselves, to understand each other, to understand our values, to understand the ultimate stakes of our actions, and to act well in response.
B2. The AI is able to help us with all of these things together as one combined process, in which growing, flourishing, self-improvement, understanding and acting well go along with each other.
B3. The AI is able to help us to grow and flourish as one joint outcome, and separately with each of the other listed aims.
B4. The AI is able to help us act well in response to the ultimate stakes of our actions only, with "in response" referring just to that last thing we come to understand.
B5. The AI is able to help us act well in response to everything we come to understand: each other, our values, and the ultimate stakes of our actions.
B6. The AI is able to help us act well in response to all of the earlier items, including our growth and our becoming the best versions of ourselves.
B7. The AI is permitted (allowed) to help us with these things, rather than this being a statement of what it is able to do.
